finding: There were several important significant differences in the outcomes between women of very advanced maternal age women and women of advanced maternal age, especially concerning hypertensive disorders and cesarean delivery rates.
mod_finding: The study found a significantly higher cesarean delivery rate in the very advanced maternal age group (≥45 years old) compared to the advanced maternal age group (35-44 years old).
birth_weight: Neonates from mothers of very advanced maternal age had significantly lower birthweights.
